entities.name: Jinno Terimund
entities.description: A craftsman and patriot of the Kingdom of Shikar who died in Chondaeh's arms after discovering Khone's plan.

entities.name: Chondaeh
entities.description: Woman Jinno loved, to whom he told Khone's plans as he died.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: Woman the Khonians wanted to control the Scarzam Dragon she would summon.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: Ruler the Khonians planned to kill.

entities.name: Kingdom of Shikar
entities.description: Jinno's kingdom, which Khone planned to overrun.

events.summary: Jinno traveled through the Great Sulgh Salt Marsh into Khone and learned the Khonians' plan to use the Scarzam Dragon to kill Sol'Kanar and overrun Shikar.
events.quote: he discovered the Khonians wanted Gydolien Mor to control the Scarzam Dragon she would summon

events.summary: Jinno was revealed as a Shikaran, escaped with poisoned arrow wounds and died in Chondaeh's arms, asking her to stop the coming danger.
events.quote: he died in the arms of Chondaeh, telling her the Khonians’ plans

relations.note: He fell in love with her.
relations.quote: He fell in love with Chondaeh .
